articles.title: From Monolithic to Modular: Segment-level Automatic Prompt Optimization
articles.title_zh: From Monolithic to Modular: Segment-level Automatic Prompt Optimization
articles.description:
arXiv:2608.11219v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) often rewrites prompts monolithically, which can improve one behavior while degrading others. We present SAPO, a segment-level APO method that decomposes prompts into role, context, tasks, and output format, then applies targeted improvements based on top-5 and bottom-5 examples. articles.title: Distribird: Literature-Informed Prior Distribution Design for Bayesian Model Calibration
articles.title_zh: Distribird: Literature-Informed Prior Distribution Design for Bayesian Model Calibration
articles.description:
arXiv:2608.11210v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Bayesian calibration of process-based models requires a prior distribution for each model parameter. Despite decades of methodological work, researchers almost always fall back on uniform priors. The main reason is that building informative priors from scientific literature is slow and needs both domain and statistical expertise.
